items.title: Anthropic Says It Will Revolutionize Biology—Some Day
items.summary: In breathless press releases and posts, the company has touted its models’ ability to deliver scientific breakthroughs. But its IPO filing taps the brakes on just how fast its AI will lead to big discoveries.
items.author: Emily Mullin

items.title: UK Home Office May Face Investigation Over Use of OpenAI Tech
items.summary: A government watchdog is considering a probe into the Home Office’s use of ChatGPT technology to process asylum claims amid concerns over the tools’ accuracy and secrecy surrounding their use.
items.author: Isabella Ward

items.title: AI Agents Are Media’s New Favorite Audience
items.summary: As agents go mainstream, some publishers are hoping that people will pay for content tailor-made for AI—not humans.
items.author: Kate Taylor

items.title: I Tested Every Major AI Agent for a Day. Here’s the Best One
items.summary: I ranked six AI agents—from Meta’s Muse to Anthropic’s Claude Duet—on how well they completed basic tasks.
items.author: Reece Rogers
